name: beehiiv MCP
description: Lets newsletter operators manage beehiiv posts, podcasts, communities, subscribers, automations, and analytics from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor over a hosted OAuth MCP server.

skills.name: Post Drafting
skills.description: Drafts, edits, and duplicates posts and templates and reads post stats, clicks, and comments; sending stays manual.

skills.name: Audience Management
skills.description: Manages subscriptions, segments, tags, custom fields, newsletter lists, and signup flows.

skills.name: Podcast Publishing
skills.description: Creates shows and episodes, uploads audio, schedules episodes, and reads transcripts and episode stats.

skills.name: Automation Journeys
skills.description: Builds journeys, triggers, and automation emails with A/B variants; activation stays a human step.

skills.name: Publication Analytics
skills.description: Reads publication and website analytics, post and podcast stats, poll and survey responses, and earnings.
